**Not under the current rules.** `is.waiwai.dictation` is marked permanent because macOS ties Accessibility grants to the bundle identifier. A new ID would make every user re-grant permission, and the old grants would be orphaned.

Two things to check before deciding:

- **Existing installs:** Sparkle won't update an app with a different bundle ID, so any beta or internal builds would stay on the old app and never update.
- **Whether the invariant still applies:** If no build with granted permissions has shipped, the stated reason may not hold. Changing a rule marked permanent should be an explicit decision, so update the rules file first, then make the rename.

I have no tools in this session, so I couldn't check the repo or any release history. If you confirm nothing with granted permissions has shipped, I can draft the rules-file change and the rename plan.
